title: OneCoin. Intro into Crypto Currency. The Evolution of Money.

asr.full_text: Hi there my name is Joby Bowley I'm a crypto rep from London and I'm 34 years of age. This is the story of cryptocurrency and how it's evolved. It first started off a 10 cent share in bitcoin and it rose to over $1200 a coin becoming one of the biggest investment opportunities in our lifetime. The very first transactions were made for 2 pizza. The two pizzas were swapped for 10,000 tokens At today's value it reach peak of $1200. 10,000 coins we will have $7.6 billion. Cryptocurrency 2.0 is born. Welcome to OneCoin. The fastest company every tier at over a billion dollars in revenue, And the second-largest cryptocurrency in the world, I am on the market with the fastest and largest company in my life. This company has $2 billion in revenue and is the world's second largest cryptocurrency in the world. There are more to show you, it has changed my whole life. For less than two months I made doubled than my job so I think that's a big opportunity for my friends and family all over the World. Groupon took two years, 8 months to hit over a $1 billion in valuation, one coin did this in a year. Bill gates has come out and said this is the tech-no-force of technology has come out and said, this is a techno force of technology. Richard Branson has said, this is the pioneer of a global currency. Citigroup have come out and they're creating their very own coin. Citicoin A consortium called RF3 that is a consortium of the biggest banks in the world that are looking into the blockchain technology that is cryptocurrency. This is a win, win situation for technology, that is cryptocurrency. This is a win win situation for everyone, whoever is part of this opportunity. When you see billionaires, banks looking into digital currency and all using it, it's got to say something. Cryptocurrency 2.0 is born. Take action and be a part of the evolution.

textual.observation: The speaker says that 10,000 coins would amount to $7.6 billion, then introduces OneCoin and urges participation.

evidence.quote: Cryptocurrency 2.0 is born. Welcome to OneCoin.
Take action and be a part of the evolution.

textual.context: Presented within a cryptocurrency history/evolution narrative followed by a promotional transition to OneCoin; it is unclear whether the $7.6 billion statement is historical, illustrative, or a forecast.
textual.potential_relevance: A very large stated coin-value outcome is paired with an explicit invitation to take action in the same promotional pitch.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish which coin the $7.6 billion figure refers to, the valuation method or timeframe, or any completed transaction.

textual.observation: The speaker reports doubling his job income in under two months, calls it a big opportunity for friends and family, and directs the audience to join or take action.

evidence.quote: For less than two months I made doubled than my job so I think that's a big opportunity for my friends and family all over the World.
Take action and be a part of the evolution.

textual.context: First-person testimonial and promotional framing; the speaker presents the earnings statement alongside participation language and a signup destination.
textual.potential_relevance: A claimed personal financial return is linked to a requested participation step and an explicit signup destination.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish the actual earnings, any required payment, signup terms, or whether the stated result is typical.

textual.observation: The speaker presents OneCoin as having over a billion dollars or $2 billion in revenue and as the world's second-largest cryptocurrency, using those claims to support participation.

textual.limitations: The records provide no independent source, timeframe, metric definition, or consistent confirmation that the claims refer to OneCoin.

textual.observation: The speaker attributes favorable statements about cryptocurrency or OneCoin to Bill Gates, Richard Branson, Citigroup and major banks, then asks listeners to take action.

textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether the named people or institutions made the quoted statements, endorsed OneCoin, or used the described technology.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speaker actively promotes OneCoin as a cryptocurrency opportunity using extraordinary company-size and personal-earnings claims, including that it generated billions in revenue and doubled his employment income in less than two months. He directs viewers to join through the supplied signup link and explicitly urges them to take action and participate, rather than presenting the claims as criticism or investigation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The video promotes participation in OneCoin and links the opportunity to cryptocurrency value and rapid financial gains. This fits S05 because token participation is presented as an opportunity associated with major growth, claimed wealth, and a direct signup pathway; no evidence establishes a paid guidance service, mining/node purchase, or qualifying multi-level hierarchy.
